services.desc: In addition to our standard inshore and offshore charters we are offering two of the BEST CHARTER FISHING VALUES at the Jersey Shore! #1: "Half Day Special" Fishing Charters for $750! Take your family, friends, customers and business associates deep sea fishing. You pick the time - morning, afternoon or after work! #2: A full blown offshore "Shark Charter Special" for $1,475! This is an 8 hour charter. It consists of a 1-1 1/2 hr. cruise to the Shark grounds, 5-6 hrs. drifting for Sharks, and 1-1 1/2 hr. return trip.
